items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Analysts Reset Lithium Assumptions
items.snippet: Scotiabank, with a target trimmed to US$190 from US$200, maintains an Outperform view. RBC Capital reduced its target to US$166 from US$257 but keeps an Outperform rating. BofA moved its target to US$155 from US$225. Morgan Stanley cut its target to US$161 from US$189.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months, underperforming the Zacks Chemical - Diversified industry decline of 7.8% and the S&P 500's 13.9% increase. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock.
